_comment: EXAMPLE simulator ingest config (PROT-SKY-001 §1-§2). No simulator data exists in this
repository yet: the paths below are placeholders for a real run directory and are not read by
any test. Copy it, point run_dir at the delivered run, and start with the 'validate' command,
which writes nothing and prints every check.
The conventions block is REQUIRED to be looked at rather than inherited: altitude_datum_ue_cm
is the UE world Z of the ground plane at the trajectory origin (PROT-001 §2.4), and
verified_by must name the R0-S convention-check recording (PROT-SKY-001 §4) once one exists.
Leaving it null is legal and is recorded as 'declared but not verified' in session.json.
